dedupe_keys.name: database of reinforced concrete jacketed concrete columns

description: Database of reinforced concrete jacketed concrete columns is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Víctor Cruz Eligio, Walter P. Moore and Associates Inc (walterpmoore.com). The present work compiles data from 41 specimens reported in nine experimental studies on the structural behavior of reinforced concrete (RC) columns retrofitted with RC jackets. During seismic events, existing structures may sustain significant damage due to lateral loading. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 2 top-level files (XLSX, TXT). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-8401-zv56. Keywords: jacketed columns, retrofitting, data compilation, seismic retrofitting. Published 2026-09-26. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
